title: Company OKR Execution Handover and Initiative Compliance Matrix
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: As we scale Dedicated and Private products, cross-functional initiatives frequently land in execution without clear tracing to company-level OKRs. This causes duplicated effort, unclear escalation paths, and makes it hard to measure initiative ROI against company objectives.

Goal: Build a repeatable "compliance matrix" and a lightweight execution-handover protocol that ensures every company-level initiative is mapped to at least one OKR, has a defined success metric, an owner, and an operational readiness checklist before work is committed to Sprints.

Scope: Company-level initiatives (Ambit A/B/C) and any cross-functional programs that span Eng, Product, Design, and GTM. Not in scope: purely team-local tickets under 5 points unless they roll up into a company initiative.

Success metrics: Number of initiatives with full OKR mapping >= 95% by end of cycle; mean time from handover to first successful rollout < 6 weeks for Q1 initiatives; reduction in post-launch escalations tied to unclear owner by 60%.
acceptance_criteria: Compliance matrix prototype (CSV + Confluence) completed and reviewed by PM/Eng/Design
Handover checklist itemized and converted into a template (Confluence + GitHub issue template)
RACI mapping convention documented and ratified by exec sponsors
Dashboard: initiative-to-OKR mapping and health indicators visible in Console (product-ops dashboard)
Two pilot initiatives go through handover protocol with retro outcomes documented
steps: Draft compliance matrix fields (OKR ID, initiative owner, KPIs, dependencies, security/regulatory tags, runway estimate)
Prototype spreadsheet and Confluence page; circulate to cross-functional leads for feedback
Work with Eng to add GitHub issue template that includes OKR mapping and readiness checklist
Instrument Console dashboard to surface initiative health and link to OKR goals
Run two pilots (Dedicated autoscaling policy, Console rollout: per-route cost breakdown) and capture learnings
Iterate on checklist and finalize playbook; present to leadership and include in quarterly planning ritual
decisions: Use existing OKR canonical IDs from company OKR ledger as the single source of truth (decision made 2025-02-18)
Adopt a 3-tier initiative classification (Company, Cross-functional, Team) to scope handovers (decision made 2025-02-21)
Require at least one quantitative KPI and one qualitative success indicator for each initiative mapping (decision made 2025-02-25)
blockers: Data engineering capacity to expose initiative-level metrics to Console dashboard (dependency ENG-4019)
Final sign-off from Legal on customer-impact tagging for Private deployment initiatives
Alignment from GTM on what constitutes an acceptable success KPI for adoption-driven goals
